stem: Which sentence best describes Carter and Max when they first notice the girls?

options.label: F
options.text: They are worried that the girls are building a better car than they are.

options.label: G
options.text: They want to change their plan and build a different sand sculpture.

options.label: H
options.text: They are not pleased that the girls are also building a sports car.

options.label: J
options.text: They decide to help the girls make their car look even better.

notes: Extracted from 2018 3rd grade reading STAAR question.
